label: NATURE_SOURCE_2: x's own form or quiddity is an efficient cause of x's having r
term: efficient causation by a thing's own quiddity (quiddityEfficientlyCauses x r)
definition: NatureSource.quiddityEfficientlyCauses x r: x's own form or quiddity is an efficient cause of x's having r ('causatum ab ipsa forma vel quiditate rei (dico sicut a causa efficiente)', De ente c.3 [69874]). Efficient means a source from which the having of r proceeds as from an agent, as the q.77 a.6 reading of a subject that actively causes its proper accidents; a merely formal principle by which x has r is excluded. Whether such causing is the thing's own causing (CausesIn x x r) is the separate source reading QuiddityCausingEsseIsSelfCausationReading, not part of this definition. In Lean it is a primitive field.

formal_gap.meaning: NatureSource.quiddityEfficientlyCauses x r says that x's own form or quiddity is an efficient cause of x's having r: the having of r proceeds from x's nature as from an agent ('dico sicut a causa efficiente', De ente c.3). It is a supplied relation between a being and a respect (NATURE_SOURCE_2).
examples: A subject that actively causes its proper accidents, on the q.77 a.6 reading (the record's example of efficient causation by a nature).
exclusions: A merely formal principle by which x has r.
The broad, mode-unspecified fromNature (NATURE_SOURCE_1); the passage from it to this efficient reading is the open bridge NatureSourcedDistinctEsseIsEfficient (disambiguation 87ac7ae0).
x's own causing as a CausesIn x x r self-edge: identifying them is the separate source reading QuiddityCausingEsseIsSelfCausationReading.
open_obligations: NatureSourcedDistinctEsseIsEfficient and QuiddityCausingEsseIsSelfCausationReading remain separate premises.
